ctaHeading: Footscray's reblocking team is ready — let's stabilise your home.
aboutText: Based in Footscray, Reblocking & Restumping Melbourne provides whole-of-house concrete stump replacement and underpinning services. We specialise in stabilising homes across Maribyrnong, Hobsons Bay and greater Melbourne. Our computer-levelled work meets engineering tolerance, ensuring your home is safe and level for decades to come.
servicesText: We offer a full range of reblocking, restumping and underpinning services to strengthen and stabilise your home. From timber to concrete conversion to levelling and lifting, we handle it all with precision.

services.title: Reblocking & Restumping
services.desc: Complete whole-of-house concrete stump replacement to support your home's foundation.

services.title: Underpinning
services.desc: Strengthening footings on brick and slab homes to prevent further movement.

services.title: Levelling & Lifting
services.desc: Computer-levelled to engineering tolerance, raising and levelling homes accurately.

services.title: Timber to Concrete Conversion
services.desc: Replacing old timber stumps with durable concrete for long-term stability.

services.title: Stabilising & Strengthening
services.desc: Bracing solutions for homes experiencing active movement or settling.

services.title: Verandahs, Slabs & Footings
services.desc: Posts, columns, footings, and bracing stumps for outdoor structures.

reviews.text: Simon and his team did an excellent job reblocking our home in Footscray. The concrete stumps are solid, and the house is perfectly level now. Highly recommend their professional service.

reviews.text: We hired them for underpinning on our brick house in Maribyrnong. The work was done efficiently, and the 15-year guarantee gives us peace of mind. Great local tradies.
reviews.name: Sarah Brown

reviews.text: Our verandah needed new footings, and they delivered top-quality work. Stabilising and strengthening done right, with no mess left behind. A reliable team in Melbourne's west.
